impact: Still unfixed: T-020 specifies a UI-path network call whose only tested failure is the easy immediate-error case; a stalled/blackholed connection has no bound and nothing cancels it. Re-spec: background check off the render path, cached result in spendbar's state dir with bounded cadence, validated finite deadline that aborts and disposes the underlying request when it fires, silent fallback to cached/absent-line on every failure, and an accept-but-never-respond server test asserting request disposal plus UI responsiveness — the same bounded-wait rule T-008 had to learn twice (findings doc lines 558-562 and 838-845).
resolution: Fixed by the v0.2/v0.3 ticket re-spec applied 2026-08-02: T-020's update check is specified off the render path: background, cached result only, finite validated deadline, fail-silent, never self-mutating. The full verified requirements record is preserved in this issue's impact field.
title: T-020's update check is an unbounded network call on the menubar render path
